mapper.sql: select a.id, a.origin_id, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_advance_collection a
mapper.delete: update t_advance_collection set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_advance_collection set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select a.advance_delivery_id as advanceDeliveryId, a.material_id as materialId, a.next_flag as nextFlag, a.plan_date as planDate, a.predict_date as predictDate, a.predict_count as predictCount, a.receive_count as receiveCount, a.detection_count as detectionCount, a.detection_fail_type as detectionFailType, a.detection_fail_remark as detectionFailRemark, a.registration_count as registrationCount, a.produced_date as producedDate, a.batch_code as batchCode, a.remark, a.create_by as createBy, a.create_time as createTime, a.dept_id as deptId, a.dept_name as deptName, b.code as materialCode , b.finance_voucher_no, b.name as materialName, c.name as unitName, d.return_count, d.id from t_advance_delivery_detail a left join t_material b on a.material_id = b.id left join t_unit c on b.unit_id = c.id left join t_advance_collection_detail d on a.id = d.detail_origin_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.advance_delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
